note: Data file for check 4 of chitra_conformance.py. A citation matching a non-current entry raises a finding. Add an entry the day an instrument is amended, superseded or repealed; do not edit the checker.

instruments.name: IT Rules 2023 amendment — online real-money gaming (self-regulatory body regime)
instruments.superseded_by: Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 (Act 32 of 2025)
instruments.note: The SRB self-regulatory mechanism was abandoned. Advertising online money games is now prohibited outright, punishable by imprisonment up to 2 years and a fine up to Rs 50 lakh. Any rule permitting real-money gaming advertising subject to conditions is unlawful.

instruments.name: ASCI AI Influencer Disclosure (fixed-label formulation)
instruments.superseded_by: ASCI Draft Guidelines for Responsible Labelling of AI-Generated Content in Advertising (8 May 2026), aligned to IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules 2026
instruments.note: ASCI has not mandated a single label format. A closed label enum over-blocks compliant work. The framework is risk-tiered and high-risk uses are prohibited outright, so a label does not cure them. Track the final text published after the 13 June 2026 consultation close.

instruments.name: ASCI Influencer Guidelines Addendum 2 (7 April 2025) — disclosure sufficiency
instruments.note: The 2026 update prohibits #collab or #partnership without #Ad, prohibits disclosures buried in hashtag clusters, requires verbal disclosure within the first 10 seconds of video and at the start of an audio brand segment, and requires full-duration disclosure on ephemeral formats. Monitoring runs through the National Advertising Monitoring Service. Addendum 2 remains valid for BFSI and health qualification disclosure. Rules relying only on the qualification-disclosure portion are exempt via exempt_ids.

instruments.name: IT Rules — deepfake and synthetic media (unnamed formulation)
instruments.superseded_by: IT (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules, 2026 (amended 10 February 2026)
instruments.note: A named instrument now exists. Citations must name it rather than gesturing at emerging regulation.

instruments.name: DPDP Rules 2025 — notification and compliance dates
instruments.superseded_by: DPDP Rules notified 13 November 2025; Phase 2 (penalties, Consent Manager registration) 13 November 2026; Phase 3 (full compliance) 13 May 2027
instruments.note: Penalties activate at Phase 2, not at the full-compliance date. Deployment planning calibrated to May 2027 is nine months out of phase.

instruments.name: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
instruments.note: Schedule lists 54 conditions. Rules citing it must enumerate all 54, not a sample.

instruments.name: Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025
instruments.note: Total prohibition on offering, facilitating and advertising online money games. E-sports recognised under the National Sports Governance Act 2025 and online social games without stakes are carved out.
